title: Harry Potter Days Out: Studio Tour, Offers & Wizarding World
description: Plan a magical Harry Potter day out: the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, Wizarding World parks, Alnwick Castle and the Jacobite steam train, plus ways to save.
h1: Harry Potter days out for the whole family
intro: From the real film sets in Leavesden to Hogwarts castles in Orlando and a steam train over the Glenfinnan Viaduct: the best Harry Potter days out, and how to pay less for the magic.

image.alt: A steam train crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct in the Scottish Highlands

blocks.title: Scout’s verdict on Harry Potter days out
blocks.text: The Studio Tour in London is the one most fans should do first: real sets, props and costumes, and children aged 4 and under go free. Don’t expect a discount code. The best saving is booking direct, early, on a term-time date.

blocks.title: The best Harry Potter days out

items.title: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London – The Making of Harry Potter

image.alt: A Platform 9¾ sign for the Hogwarts Express

items.text: Walk through the real sets, costumes and props from the films, including the Great Hall, Diagon Alley and the Hogwarts Express on Platform 9¾.
saves: Children aged 4 and under go free, but still need a ticket
Book direct on the official site to avoid reseller mark-ups
Tickets can’t be bought on arrival, and school holidays sell out early
items.scout: Allow at least 3–4 hours. Save room for Butterbeer, and don’t rush the Gringotts and Hogwarts model sections at the end.

items.title: Platform 9¾ at King’s Cross

image.alt: A red steam locomotive on a railway line

items.text: A luggage trolley disappearing into the wall at King’s Cross station, with a themed shop next to it. Taking your own photo is free.
saves: Free to visit: you only pay if you want the official photo or shop souvenirs
Go early in the morning to beat the queue
items.scout: A fun free stop on a London day out. Combine it with the free museums in South Kensington.

items.title: Alnwick Castle

image.alt: A stone castle under white clouds

items.text: The castle used for Hogwarts exteriors in the first two Harry Potter films. Families can join broomstick training in the very courtyard from the movies.
saves: Check whether tickets can be upgraded to an annual pass for free on the official site
Pair with Alnwick Garden next door
items.scout: Broomstick training is pure joy for young witches and wizards. Check session times when you arrive.

items.title: The Jacobite steam train

image.alt: A steam train crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct in the Scottish Highlands

items.text: The steam train that crosses the Glenfinnan Viaduct, famous from the Harry Potter films. It runs seasonally and sells out well ahead.
saves: You can watch the train cross the viaduct for free from the Glenfinnan viewpoints
Book as early as possible for summer dates
items.scout: Can’t get tickets? Watching it cross the viaduct from the hillside is free and just as photogenic.

items.title: Universal Orlando Resort

image.alt: A castle-style building lit up at night

items.text: Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure and Epic Universe (opened 2025), plus Volcano Bay water park. The Wizarding World of Harry Potter is spread across all three theme parks.
saves: Multi-day tickets are better value per day
For 2026, 3-day-plus tickets include Epic Universe visits; 2-day tickets don’t, so check before you buy
You need a park-to-park ticket to ride the Hogwarts Express between the two original parks
items.scout: Harry Potter fans: Diagon Alley and Hogsmeade are in different parks. Get a park-to-park ticket or you’ll miss half the magic.

items.title: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo – The Making of Harry Potter

image.alt: A castle-style building lit up at night

items.text: Opened in 2023, Tokyo’s Studio Tour brings sets, props and costumes from the films to Japan. Book in advance.
saves: Book direct on the official site for timed entry
items.scout: Visiting Japan? Universal Studios Japan has its own Wizarding World too.

blocks.title: Harry Potter savings that actually work
blocks.intro: Searching for a “Harry Potter World discount code”? Genuine public codes for the Studio Tour are rare. These savings are real:

items.title: Book direct, and under-5s go free
items.text: Children aged 4 and under go free with a ticket. Booking on the official site avoids reseller mark-ups. Transport packages cost more.
items.terms: Advance booking only: no tickets on arrival.

items.title: Travel by train and check the Days Out Guide
items.text: The Days Out Guide lists rail-ticket offers at attractions. Check the live listing for current London and Hertfordshire offers before you travel.
items.nocode: No code: voucher or booking reference
items.terms: Valid National Rail ticket needed. Oyster, contactless and TfL tickets don’t qualify. Some offers need pre-booking.

items.title: Watch the “Hogwarts Express” for free
items.text: The Jacobite steam train crosses the Glenfinnan Viaduct on its seasonal runs. Watching from the viewpoints costs nothing.
items.terms: Seasonal timetable. Car parks get busy.

sections.h2: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London: the essentials
sections.html:
• Where: Leavesden, near Watford, about 20 miles north-west of central London. Shuttle buses run from Watford Junction station.
  • Tickets: timed entry, booked in advance only. Children aged 4 and under go free, but still need a ticket.
  • How long: most families spend 3 to 4 hours.
  • When: school holidays and weekends sell out early, so book as soon as you know your dates.

Read Scout’s full Studio Tour tips for families. Visiting from the US or Europe? You’ll need a UK ETA before you fly.

sections.h2: The Wizarding World of Harry Potter parks
sections.html: Universal runs Wizarding World areas in Orlando, Hollywood and Japan. In Orlando, Hogsmeade is at Islands of Adventure, Diagon Alley is at Universal Studios Florida, and the newest land (the Ministry of Magic) is at Epic Universe. See our Epic Universe family guide, and compare Orlando holidays on TravelDeals.

faqs.q: Is there a discount code for the Harry Potter Studio Tour?
faqs.a: Genuine public discount codes are rare. The most reliable savings are booking direct on the official website (avoiding reseller mark-ups), choosing an off-peak date and remembering that children aged 4 and under go free with a ticket.

faqs.q: Can you buy Harry Potter Studio Tour tickets on the day?
faqs.a: No. Tickets must be booked in advance online for a timed entry slot. Popular dates, especially school holidays, can sell out weeks or months ahead.

faqs.q: Is the Studio Tour suitable for young children?
faqs.a: Children of any age can visit, and under-5s go free. It’s a walking tour of sets and props rather than rides, so it suits children who know the films, usually from about age 5 upwards.
